create_components_manager: create a ComponentsManager to register and track model components across multiple pipelines
build_auto_cpu_offload: build automatic CPU offloading for registered model components using an AutoOffloadStrategy
search_components_by_pattern: search ComponentsManager for components matching name patterns like wildcards or OR expressions
get_component_info: get comprehensive metadata about a registered model component including size, device, and adapters
summarize_components_table: summarize all registered components into a formatted table showing name, class, device, and size
